query:
update mail set categorie = $2, categorie_par = 'humain', tri_etat = 'trie', trie_le = now(),
            tri_message = null,
            statut_reponse = case
                when $2 = 'question' then coalesce(statut_reponse, 'a_repondre')
                when statut_reponse = 'a_repondre' then null
                else statut_reponse end
         where id = $1
